manufacturing-process.title: From Raw Material to Ready-to-Ship Packaging.
manufacturing-process.subtitle: Every corrugated box goes through a carefully coordinated manufacturing process. From selecting quality raw materials to final inspection, each stage focuses on strength, precision and consistency.

stages.title: Raw Material Selection
stages.description: Selection of suitable kraft paper and raw materials for corrugated board production.
technicalSpecs: 120 to 450 GSM Virgin Kraft & Semi-Chemical Fluting
Burst Factor (BF) certified Indian & imported paper mills
Moisture controlled roll storage with traceability codes

stages.title: Corrugation & Board Formation
stages.description: Paper layers are combined with fluted paper to create corrugated sheets with the required construction.
technicalSpecs: Automated steam-heated fingerless single & double facers
B, C, and E flute configurations for 3, 5, and 7-ply board
Corn-starch ecological adhesive bonding under pressure

stages.title: Printing & Branding
stages.description: Customized designs, colours and product information are printed according to customer requirements.
technicalSpecs: Up to 4-color high-speed flexographic printing units
Water-based non-toxic food-safe and eco inks
Sharp barcode compliance and transit warning symbols

stages.title: Die-Cutting & Slotting
stages.description: Corrugated sheets are cut, creased and shaped according to the required box dimensions and design.
technicalSpecs: Rotary & flatbed precision CNC die-cutting cylinders
Micrometer-accurate scoring lines for crisp folding edges
Self-locking flap cuts, hand holes, and ventilation slots

stages.title: Folding & Box Assembly
stages.description: Cut sheets are folded, glued or stitched to form finished corrugated packaging boxes.
technicalSpecs: High-speed computerized folder-gluer with squaring section
Hot-melt and PVA cold adhesive dispensing systems
Heavy-duty rust-proof wire stitching for industrial crates

stages.title: Quality Inspection & Dispatch
stages.description: Finished boxes are checked for construction, dimensions and finishing before packaging and dispatch.
technicalSpecs: Edge Crush Test (ECT) & Box Compression Test (BCT) verified
Automated bundle strapping and moisture-barrier stretch wrap
Scheduled fleet dispatch with guaranteed logistics lead time

box-construction.title: Choose the Right Strength for Your Packaging
box-construction.subtitle: Understanding box construction and material specifications helps you choose packaging that protects your products throughout storage and transportation.
box-construction.cutawayDescription: Corrugated board is an engineered composite paper material. Hover over each layer on the image or below to inspect its structural role.

cutawayLayers.title: Outer Liner
cutawayLayers.description: The external flat paper layer providing puncture resistance and a smooth surface for commercial printing and labeling.

cutawayLayers.title: Fluted Medium
cutawayLayers.description: The wave-shaped middle layer that creates protective air cushions and acts as continuous structural arches resisting top-to-bottom compression.

cutawayLayers.title: Inner Liner
cutawayLayers.description: The internal flat paper layer that holds the fluted arches in permanent geometry and protects internal cargo from abrasion.

plyOptions.name: 3 Ply – Single Wall
plyOptions.layersSummary: Outer Liner • Fluted Medium • Inner Liner
plyOptions.description: One fluted layer between two flat liner sheets. Suitable for lightweight products and general-purpose packaging.

plyOptions.name: 5 Ply – Double Wall
plyOptions.layersSummary: Outer Liner • Flute 1 • Middle Liner • Flute 2 • Inner Liner
plyOptions.description: Two fluted layers between three liner sheets. Suitable for medium-to-heavy products, storage and transportation.
bestFor: Master outer shipping cartons & export boxes

plyOptions.name: 7 Ply – Triple Wall
plyOptions.layersSummary: Outer Liner • 3 Fluted Mediums • 2 Center Liners • Inner Liner
plyOptions.description: Three fluted layers between four liner sheets. Suitable for demanding packaging applications and heavier industrial goods.
bestFor: Bulk chemical and bulk agricultural exports
Wooden crate replacement for international freight

selectionRequirements.title: Lightweight Products
selectionRequirements.examples: Lightweight retail goods, apparel, cosmetics, personal care and general-purpose e-commerce parcels.
selectionRequirements.explanation: A single fluted layer enclosed by two flat liners delivers adequate rigidity and cost-effective physical protection without adding dead freight weight.

selectionRequirements.title: Medium to Heavy Products
selectionRequirements.examples: Industrial components, consumer appliances, glassware, lubricants and multi-tier palletized freight.
selectionRequirements.explanation: Two fluted chambers cushioned between three paper liners deliver exceptional vertical stacking resistance and shock absorption during transit.

selectionRequirements.title: Heavy-Duty Applications
selectionRequirements.examples: Automotive engine parts, heavy metal castings, pumps, chemical drums and export sea shipments.
selectionRequirements.explanation: Engineered with four heavy paper liners and three high-strength fluted arches, this construction offers structural rigidity capable of substituting wooden packaging.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on flute selections, burst factor testing, custom dimensions, and minimum order quantities.

faqs.q: What is a corrugated box and how is it constructed?
faqs.a: A corrugated box is made of wavy arched paper (fluting) sandwiched between flat kraft paper liners. This arched structure creates air cushions that provide high stacking strength and impact protection during shipping.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 3-ply, 5-ply, and 7-ply boxes?
faqs.a: 3-ply (Single Wall) has 1 fluted layer for lightweight goods and e-commerce. 5-ply (Double Wall) has 2 fluted layers for master shipping and appliances. 7-ply (Triple Wall) has 3 fluted layers for heavy industrial machinery and export freight.

faqs.q: Can boxes be customized in exact dimensions and printing?
faqs.a: Yes. All boxes can be manufactured to your exact internal size (Length × Width × Height) to avoid wasted space. We also offer multi-colour brand printing, barcodes, and custom artwork on kraft or white liners.

faqs.q: Which flute profile is suitable for my specific packaging needs?
faqs.a: B-Flute (~3mm) is best for puncture resistance and sharp printing. C-Flute (~4mm) delivers maximum vertical stacking strength for warehouse storage. BC Double Wall combines both for heavy-duty protection.

faqs.q: How do I request a technical consultation or production quote?
faqs.a: Simply share your box dimensions, product weight, ply choice, and estimated quantity via our online form or phone. Our engineering desk will recommend the optimal paper GSM and share a detailed quotation within 24 hours.
